caption_hook: 🐢 A loggerhead sea turtle tangled in fishing nets in 2019 heads back to the sea after 7 surgeries + 3 more wins you missed 👇
question: Drop a 🐢 if you'd cheer this turtle back into the waves
share_line: Send this to the friend who loves sea turtles
reel_hook: 7 years, 7 surgeries: a sea turtle goes home
first_comment: Bonus: it goes back without a tracker or tag, so nothing slows it down. The beach was picked so it can crawl to the water on its own. Would you watch? 🐢

stories.headline: After 7 years of care, a rescued sea turtle goes home
stories.summary: Found on a Jeju beach in 2019, its shoulder and throat hurt by fishing gear, the loggerhead needed 7 surgeries at Aqua Planet Jeju. Now healthy, it returns to the sea near where it was found.
stories.why: Loggerheads are vulnerable, so every one returned to the ocean counts.

stories.stat_label: years this Roman fort held the border
stories.headline: A Roman temple to Mars was hiding just under a forest floor
stories.summary: At Kapersburg fort near Frankfurt, diggers found a village with workshops and a temple likely for Mars, plus pieces of a statue of Victoria. Untouched by farming, the forest kept the layers intact.
stories.why: A rare, complete look at daily life on Rome's frontier.

stories.stat_label: years old, a dinosaur new to science
stories.headline: A 210-million-year-old dinosaur shows Zimbabwe's lost world
stories.summary: Musango, a 4.5 m, 220 kg plant-eater that walked on 2 legs, was found on Lake Kariba's shore. It and its relatives are unique to Zimbabwe, not copies of South Africa's dinosaurs.
stories.why: Africa's early dinosaur story is richer than anyone thought.

stories.stat_label: donated bikes for families in need
stories.headline: A 17-year-old raised $30,000 to give kids bikes and lessons
stories.summary: Triathlete Jonathan Thai started Pedal Forward after a free bike workshop closed. He has handed out 400 donated bikes and 500 helmets, and his clinics now run in 3 US states.
stories.why: A bike can mean getting to school, groceries or a job.

fun_fact: Loggerheads are named for their big heads, which power jaws strong enough to crush shellfish.
